Publication hold check, re-run 2026-11-18 PST (rebar-session-3d705fec) with the final tame-melodious-veery build (91953e1ecf6, Gerrit 3431). I ran enforced `verify-identity --all` (`REBAR_IDENTITY_REQUIRE_AUTHENTICATED=1`, no `enforce_since`) on the rewritten dry-run history (shadow at fb999892b1e, 12,675 commits, no remote). It completed in 20 min 19 s and FAILED with exit 1: 42,612 verified, 874 unsigned, 0 unknown-author, 7,007 bad-signature, 0 key-not-valid-at-era (50,493 in scope). These counts are identical to the original history T0 b878d77e28d.

The hold condition is not met. Publication stays held, and nothing was published, pushed, reset or force-updated. The failing verdicts predate the reclaim. Their cause is in starving-sphalerite-skua: MCP writes are signed with op-cert environment keys that are not on identity 594c's keyring, and 1,320 ledger entries had a null signer recorded although they verify. Clearing the hold needs an operator decision there.
